title: Priyanka Chopra Wishes New Mommy Parineeti On Birthday, Gushes Over 'Most Precious Gift' | Bollywood News - News18
text: It’s celebration time in the Chadha household! Bollywood actress Parineeti Chopra and her husband, Aam Aadmi Party leader Raghav Chadha, are not only marking Diwali but also the arrival of their first child — a baby boy — and Parineeti’s birthday. The couple, who tied the knot in 2023, welcomed their little bundle of joy earlier this month, making this birthday extra special for the actress. Announcing the joyous news, the new parents had shared in a joint statement, “He’s finally here! Our Baby Boy. And we literally can’t believe our life before! Arms full, our hearts are fuller. First we had each other, now we have everything. With gratitude, Parineeti and Raghav." Priyanka Chopra’s Heartfelt Birthday Message Global star Priyanka Chopra Jonas showered love on her cousin, posting a sweet birthday message that beautifully captured the emotion of the moment. Sharing an adorable throwback photo with Parineeti, Priyanka wrote, “Happy Birthday Tisha! This birthday month brought you the most precious gift, and I can’t wait to see all the joy and love he brings into your life." Priyanka, who is currently in Los Angeles with husband Nick Jonas and daughter Malti Marie, had earlier taken to her Instagram Story to congratulate the new parents when the baby was born. Her latest post, brimming with sisterly affection, struck a chord with fans who adored the Chopra cousins’ close bond. Raghav Chadha’s Emotional Note For His Wife Raghav Chadha also marked Parineeti’s special day with an emotional post. Sharing unseen photos of his wife during her pregnancy, he wrote, “Happy birthday to the newest and the bestest mommy in town. What an incredible journey it’s been from Girlfriend to Wife to Mother of our little boy." His heartfelt tribute quickly went viral, with fans flooding the comments section with congratulations and birthday wishes for the actress. Parineeti and Raghav had announced their pregnancy in September with a beautiful post that read, “Our little universe… on its way. Blessed beyond measure."
